Start with a single point at the origin of the square grid. At each step, add a point adjacent to an existing point in such a way that the maximum number of existing points on a line through the new point is as small as possible. In case of ties, compare the number of points on the line with the next largest number of points, etc. If there is still a tie, choose the lexicographically largest point. a(n) is the number of points that have been added when n collinear points first appear.

Number of (3+1)X(n+1) arrays of permutations of 0..n*4+3 with each element having directed index change -1,0 0,2 -1,-2 or 1,0.

4 X 4 square grid graph coloring a rectangular array: number of n X 1 0..15 arrays where 0..15 label nodes of the square grid graph and every array movement to a horizontal or vertical neighbor moves along an edge of this graph.
Number of n-step anisotropic spirals on cubic lattice.
Number of n X 3 array permutations with each element not moving, or moving one space E, S or NW.
Number of 3 X 5 matrices with elements in 0..n with each row and each column in nondecreasing order. 3,5,n can be permuted, see formula.
Number of length n arrays of permutations of 0..n-1 with each element moved by -4 to 4 places and exactly one more element moved upwards than downwards.
Number of collinear point 4-tuples in an n X n .. X n 6-dimensional cubical grid.
Number of defective 3-colorings of a 2 X n 0..2 array connected horizontally and antidiagonally with exactly one mistake, and colors introduced in row-major 0..2 order.
Number of n-step self-avoiding walks on the square lattice with diagonals allowed (Moore neighborhood).
Number of permutations of 1..n with the sequence of sums of 6 adjacent elements having exactly 2 maxima.
Number of permutations of length n which avoid the patterns 3421, 4123, 4213.
Number of 5-matchings of the n X n grid graph.
Number of permutations of {1, ..., n+6} with deficiencies #{i : p(i) < i} exceeding exceedances #{i : p(i) > i} by n or more.
Number of (1+1) X (n+1) arrays of permutations of 0..n*2+1 with each element having directed index change 0,0 0,1 1,0 -1,0 or 0,-2.
Number of permutations avoiding 321 of length 3n composed of only 3-cycles.
1/16 the number of permutations of 0..n having exactly 3 maxima.

Number of rooted plane trees of total weight n whose nodes are themselves planted plane trees whose roots are distinguished as either red or blue, the weight of each such node being equal to the size of the corresponding planted tree.

Number of even entries in the top rows of all 2-compositions of n. A 2-composition of n is a nonnegative matrix with two rows, such that each column has at least one nonzero entry and whose entries sum up to n.

Number of maximal rectangles in all L-convex polyominoes of semiperimeter n. An L-convex polyomino is a convex polyomino where any two cells can be connected by a path internal to the polyomino and which has at most 1 change of direction (i.e., one of the four orientations of the letter L). A maximal rectangle in an L-convex polyomino P is a rectangle included in P that is maximal with respect to inclusion.
Number of length n arrays of permutations of 0..n-1 with each element moved by -4 to 4 places and equal numbers of elements moved upwards and downwards.
Number of dyslexic identity planted planar trees with n+1 nodes and leaves of 2 colors.

Number of (n+2)X(6+2) nonnegative integer arrays with all values the knight distance from the upper left minus as much as 1, with successive minimum path knight move differences either 0 or +1, and any unreachable value zero.
Number of hill-free Dyck paths of semilength n+3 and having no peaks at level 2 (a Dyck path is said to be hill-free if it has no peaks at level 1).
Number of 5X5 0..n matrices whose square is also a 0..n matrix.
Number of nonequivalent ways to place 6 points on an n X n square grid so that no more than 2 points are on a vertical or horizontal straight line.
Number of strictly increasing arrangements of n nonzero numbers in -(n+3)..(n+3) with sum zero.
Number of n-colorings of the vertices of the 5-dimensional cross polytope such that no two adjacent vertices have the same color.
Number of permutations of length n which avoid the patterns 3421, 4123, 4231; or avoid the patterns 1342, 3142, 4213.

3 X 3 X 3 triangular graph coloring a rectangular array: number of n X 1 0..5 arrays where 0..5 label nodes of a graph with edges 0,1 0,2 1,2 1,3 1,4 2,4 3,4 2,5 4,5 and every array movement to a horizontal or vertical neighbor moves along an edge of this graph.
Number of defective 3-colorings of a 2Xn 0..2 array connected horizontally and antidiagonally with exactly two mistakes, and colors introduced in row-major 0..2 order.
Number of ways to arrange 7 indistinguishable points on an n X n X n triangular grid so that no three points are in the same row or diagonal.
Number of compositions of n with exactly eight descents.
The number of n-step self-avoiding walks in a 5-dimensional hypercubic lattice with no non-contiguous adjacencies.
Number of rooted self-avoiding king's walks of n moves on an infinite chessboard with first move specified.
Number of length n+1 0..5 arrays with the sum of the squares of adjacent differences multiplied by some arrangement of +-1 equal to zero.
Number of independent vertex sets and vertex covers in the n X n queen graph.
Number of permutations of 1..n with the sequence of sums of 7 adjacent elements having exactly 2 maxima.
Number of boundary guillotine partitions of a 4-dimensional box obtained with n cuts.
